title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Aaron Banks (knee) at practice Wednesday
items.desc: Aaron Banks was practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Banks had a sleeve on his left leg. He was inactive in Week 1.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Pierre Strong Jr. (hamstring) practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Pierre Strong Jr. is practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Strong missed time last week. He is on the Packers practice squad.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Warren Brinson (calf) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Warren Brinson is not practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Brinson is sidelined with a calf injury.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cal Adomitis signs with Dolphins
items.desc: The Dolphins signed Cal Adomitis to their practice squad.
items.impact: Adomitis will add depth for Miami.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaylin Simpson signs with Dolphins active roster
items.desc: The Dolphins signed CB Jaylin Simpson to the active roster.
items.impact: Simpson will add depth in the secondary for Miami.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kyle Louis (knee) placed on IR
items.desc: The Dolphins placed safety Kyle Louis on injured reserve.
items.impact: Louis suffered an MCL sprain. He will miss at least the next four games.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Amani Oruwariye signs with Ravens
items.desc: The Ravens signed Amani Oruwariye to the practice squad.
items.impact: Oruwariye will add depth for Baltimore.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Mansoor Delane (shoulder) could play in Week 2
items.desc: Chiefs head coach Andy Reid said Mansoor Delane has a pretty good shot to play Week 2.
items.impact: Delane had an MRI after he injured his shoulder getting tackled after his intercpetion on Monday. He did not return to the game.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Brian Thomas Jr. (shoulder) practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Brian Thomas Jr. was seen practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Thomss exited last Sunday's game early with a shoulder issue. It appears he was able to avoid a serious issue.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jalen McMillan (knee) logs full practice Wednesday
items.desc: Jalen McMillan (knee) logged a full practice session on Wednesday.
items.impact: McMillan was able to log a full practice session on Wednesday after missing the season opener last week due to a knee injury. It looks like he will be ready to play in time for Sunday's game against the Browns, which isn't great news for the involvement of rookie Ted Hurst III moving forward.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Behren Morton (illness) practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Behren Morton is practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel said Morton was dealing with an illness on Monday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tyrone Tracy Jr. (illness) absent from practice Wednesday
items.desc: Tyrone Tracy Jr. (illness) is absent from New York's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Tracy is reportedly dealing with a case of the flu and is not present for New York's practice on Wednesday. It sounds like this is something that could affect his availability for Sunday's game, and if he is limited or sidelined because of it, Devin Singletary would be primed for more work in his absence.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Michael Coats Jr. (ankle) practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Michael Coats Jr. practiced on Wednesday.
items.impact: Coats missed some time with an ankle injury. He is on the practice squad.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Teven Jenkins (back) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Teven Jenkins did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Jenkins was ruled out last week to open the season. His status remains uncertain for Week 2.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Zay Flowers (hamstring) not seen practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Zay Flowers (hamstring) was not spotted at practice for the Ravens on Wednesday.
items.impact: It looks like Flowers may not be participating at practice on Wednesday, as he was not spotted during the portion of practice open to the media. The official injury report will be released later and will give us more information, but this is a situation that fantasy managers should keep close tabs on throughout the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) expected to 'do more' at practice Wednesday
items.desc: TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) is expected to 'do more' at New England's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: According to HC Mike Vrabel, Henderson is expected to 'do more' at practice after being limited in the team's first unofficial practice of the week on Monday. It seems like he is trending in the right direction for Week 2, but the team is clearly taking it easy with his recovery and hasn't committed to his availability for this week's game. Fantasy managers should continue to monitor his status throughout the week, as Rhamondre Stevenson will likely be a great play if the young running back misses another game.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Chig Okonkwo (hamstring) won't practice Wednesday
items.desc: Chig Okonkwo (hamstring) won't take part in Washington's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Okonkwo is going to miss Wednesday's practice while tending to a hamstring injury of some kind. It's possible that it will lead to him missing Sunday's game against the Cowboys, and if that's the case, John Bates will likely step up and see a bit more work in his absence.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: KhaDarel Hodge promoted to 49ers' active roster
items.desc: KhaDarel Hodge has been promoted to San Francisco's 53-man active roster.
items.impact: Hodge is being promoted to San Francisco's active roster after an impressive performance on special teams in the 49ers' season opener last week. This also helps shore up the team's depth at wide receiver after placing rookie De'Zhaun Stribling (ankle) on injured reserve. The veteran is unlikely to be relevant for fantasy purposes at any point, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: De'Zhaun Stribling (ankle) officially placed on injured reserve
items.desc: De'Zhaun Stribling (ankle) has officially been placed on injured reserve and will be sidelined for the next four weeks at least.
items.impact: The 49ers' promising rookie wideout suffered an ankle injury during the team's season opener and is now landing on injured reserve as a result. He is going to be sidelined for at least four weeks while on IR, and his absence could extend beyond that depending on how his recovery goes. In the meantime, fantasy managers should expect Deebo Samuel Sr. and Demarcus Robinson to see an increase in work in the absence of Stribling.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Da'Shawn Hand (quad) placed on injured reserve
items.desc: Da'Shawn Hand (quad) has been placed on injured reserve.
items.impact: As expected, Hand will officially land on injured reserve. He is officially sidelined for at least the next four weeks, but it has been reported that he is actually likely to miss the rest of the season due to this injury, although that has yet to be officially confirmed. His absence will further weaken an already underwhelming Falcons' defensive front.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Nick Muse signs with Falcons' active roster
items.desc: Nick Muse signed a deal with the Falcons to join their active roster from their practice squad.
items.impact: Muse is now joining Atlanta's active roster after spending time on their practice squad. He is unlikely to be a consistent contributor for them moving forward, however, making him irrelevant for fantasy purposes at this point.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Khalil Herbert signing with Falcons' practice squad
items.desc: Khalil Herbert is signing a deal with the Falcons to join their practice squad.
items.impact: Herbert was previously a relevant depth running back in the NFL for several years and will now be joining the Falcons' practice squad to be a deep depth piece for them. He isn't likely to be relevant moving forward, however, with Brian Robinson serving as the backup and the injured Trey Sermon likely to return at some point this season.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Cooper Rush (back) not fully healthy, likely to practice in full Wednesday
items.desc: Cooper Rush (back) is not fully healthy at this point but is still expected to be a full participant in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Rush was Atlanta's starting quarterback last week due to all of the injuries that they are dealing with, but he is still managing a back issue himself and is not considered fully healthy at this point. He is still expected to practice in full on Wednesday, however, and may be trending towards starting again in Week 2 with Tua Tagovailoa (oblique) set to miss practice on Wednesday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tua Tagovailoa (oblique) won't practice Wednesday
items.desc: Tua Tagovailoa (oblique) won't practice for the Falcons on Wednesday.
items.impact: Tagovailoa is going to miss Atlanta's first practice of the week on Wednesday. That's a bad sign for his availability for Week 2, and if he doesn't return to practice on Thursday, it looks like we will either get another week of Cooper Rush or Michael Penix Jr. (knee) will make his season debut against the Panthers. The team is not yet sharing details on their quarterback plan for this week's game or for Wednesday's practice, so this is a situation worth monitoring throughout the week for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Joey Porter Jr. (back) to practice Wednesday
items.desc: Steelers head coach Mike McCarthy told reporters that CB Joey Porter Jr. is expected to be a full participant in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Porter was inactive last week against the Falcons. He has been seeking a new contract since the offseason.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Dalen Cambre signs with Giants
items.desc: The Giants signed Dalen Cambre to their practice squad.
items.impact: Cambre returns to the Giants in a depth role.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kitan Crawford (ankle) placed on IR
items.desc: The Cardinals placed S Kitan Crawford on injured reserve.
items.impact: Crawford was carted off on Sunday after he suffered a mid-ankle sprain. He will miss at least the next four games.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Sean Tucker (hamstring) practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Sean Tucker was seen practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Tucker was ruled out last week to start the season. His presence at practice to begin the week gives him a chance to make his season debut in Week 2.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Xavier Newman released by Jets
items.desc: The Jets released OL Xavier Newman from their practice squad.
items.impact: Newman will figure to seek another opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaden Keller released by Jets
items.desc: The Jets released LB Jaden Keller from their practice squad.
items.impact: Keller will figure to seek another opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: John Saunders Jr. signs with Jets
items.desc: The Jets signed S John Saunders to the practice squad.
items.impact: Saunders will add depth in the secondary for the Jets.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Gary Jennings Jr. signs with Chargers
items.desc: The Chargers signed WR Gary Jennings Jr.
items.impact: Jennings was released by the Chargers last week. He returns with Keandre Lambert-Smith placed on IR.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Gage Larvadain signs with Ravens
items.desc: The Ravens signed WR/KR Gage Larvadain to their practice squad.
items.impact: Larvadain will add depth at wide receiver and on special teams for Baltimore.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Britain Covey signs with Eagles active roster
items.desc: The Eagles signed WR Britain Covey to their 53-man roster.
items.impact: Covey will add depth in the wide receiver room for Philadelphia.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Marquez Valdes-Scantling signs with Chargers
items.desc: The Chargers signed wide receiver Marquez Valdes-Scantling to the practice squad.
items.impact: Valdes-Scantling had a successful workout on Tuesday. It is unclear if this relates to the injury for Ladd McConkey.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jack Stoll signs with 49ers
items.desc: The 49ers signed TE Jack Stoll to their practice squad.
items.impact: Stoll will add depth with Jake Tonges dealing with an MCL injury.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Frankie Luvu (groin) expected to avoid IR
items.desc: Commanders LB Frankie Luvu suffered a groin strain in Week 1 and is "expected to avoid IR."
items.impact: Luvu left the Commanders' Week 1 loss to the Eagles with the injury. His status is up in the air for Week 2 against the Cowboys.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kenneth Murray Jr. signs with Texans
items.desc: The Texans signed LB Kenneth Murray to their practice squad.
items.impact: Murray had a successful workout with Houston on Tuesday. He is a former first-round pick of the Chargers.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: John Bates catches two passes in Week 1
items.desc: John Bates caught two of his three targets for 13 yards in the Commanders' 24-22 loss to the Philadelphia Eagles in Week 1.
items.impact: Bates saw minimal involvement in a disappointing Washington passing attack, averaging just 6.5 yards per catch in the loss. The tight end can remain off rosters in all formats, with a Week 2 divisional contest against the Dallas Cowboys up next.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Jalen Hurts tosses three touchdowns in Week 1 win over Commanders
items.desc: Jalen Hurts completed 14-of-25 pass attempts for 203 yards and three touchdowns while also rushing seven times for 46 yards in the Eagles' 24-22 Week 1 win over the Washington Commanders.
items.impact: Hurts made the most of an inconsistent season-opening performance behind center, averaging 14.5 yards per completion in the win. The quarterback will look to reward fantasy managers with more explosive dual-threat production in a favorable Week 2 matchup against the Tennessee Titans.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Saquon Barkley leads backfield attack in Week 1 win over Commanders
items.desc: Saquon Barkley carried the ball 15 times for 83 yards while also catching one of his two targets for a loss of three yards in the Eagles' 24-22 Week 1 win over the Washington Commanders.
items.impact: Barkley made the most of what the Washington defense gave him, averaging 5.5 yards per carry in the win. The running back will look to offer fantasy managers a dynamic RB1 option in a favorable Week 2 matchup against the Tennessee Titans.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Dontayvion Wicks finds end zone in Week 1 win
items.desc: Dontayvion Wicks hauled in two of his four targets for 73 yards and one touchdown in the Eagles' 24-22 Week 1 win over the Washington Commanders.
items.impact: Wicks made the most of his modest target share in the season opener, averaging 36.5 yards per reception in the win. The wideout offers head coach Nick Sirianni another explosive pass-catching option moving forward, with a favorable Week 2 matchup against the Tennessee Titans up next.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Dallas Goedert hauls in two touchdowns in Week 1 win over Commanders
items.desc: Dallas Goedert hauled in four of his five targets for 77 yards and two touchdowns in the Eagles' 24-22 Week 1 win over the Washington Commanders.
items.impact: Goedert made the most of his involvement in the Philadelphia passing attack in the season opener, leading the team in receiving yards in the win. The tight end offers fantasy managers a steady TE1 option entering a favorable Week 2 contest against the Tennessee Titans.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Nick Nash works out for Packers
items.desc: The Packers hosted WR Nick Nash for a workout.
items.impact: Nash will compete to earn a depth role on the practice squad for Green Bay.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: DeVonta Smith catches three passes in Week 1 win
items.desc: DeVonta Smith caught three of his six targets for 53 yards in the Eagles' 24-22 Week 1 win over the Washington Commanders.
items.impact: The wideout was mostly held in check despite leading the team in targets, finishing behind tight end Dallas Goedert and No. 2 wideout Dontayvion Wicks in receiving yards on the win. The wideout remains one of the more explosive options in the Philadelphia passing attack, with an opportunity to get back on track against the Tennessee Titans in Week 2 up next.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: JuJu Smith-Schuster works out for Jets
items.desc: The Jets worked out WR JuJu Smith-Schuster.
items.impact: Smith-Schuster was released by the Giants before the start of the season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist) expected to undergo surgery, miss one month
items.desc: Ravens WR Ja'Kobi Lane is expected to undergo surgery in the coming days.
items.impact: Lane could undergo surgery as early as Wednesday. They are hopeful he'll only miss about one month.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Makai Lemon quiet in Week 1
items.desc: Makai Lemon caught three of his four targets for a loss of five yards on the Eagles' 24-22 win over the Washington Commanders in Week 1.
items.impact: Lemon struggled to find any success in the season opener, as the pass-catcher was bottled up by the Commanders defense in the win. The wideout will look for more impactful output in a favorable Week 2 matchup against the Tennessee Titans.
